Name: JA Chimken
Author: Jed5729
Description:
Hi, this is my first mod <3

So, basically, this mod adds a Club to the game called "Chimken", you can purchase it for 1 million gold from Krobus in the sewers. It is pretty powerful.

I hope you like the mod :)

Downloads.Description: Make sure you download all the required mods, unzip them into the Mods folder, and unzip this file to Mods folder.

Manifest.Name: (JA) Chimken
Manifest.Description: This mod adds a chimken weapon (club) to Stardew Valley.
